_note: THIS factory's adjudicated residuals for the ledger ref-role leg (tools/patrol_host_state.py::ledger_ref_roles_leg, #330). The leg reads every receipt whose detail asserts a ROLE for a named row -- `intake row n=X`, `dispatch row n=Y`, `close row n=Z` -- and requires that row's event to BE that role. An entry here is a residual a lane has READ and judged: the reason must name the class (CROSS-FACTORY / QUOTATION / DISCARDED LINEAGE / STALE) and say why the prose is either correct or already named by a correction row. An entry is VISIBLE DEBT, printed as a `DECLARED -- <reason>` line on every run, and an entry matching no live mismatch is itself a PROBLEM: a store that has rotted into a rubber stamp is visible on the round it rots. Keyed by the TRIPLE (row, asserted, asserted_row), because one row can carry several assertions and each is adjudicated on its own. Absent or empty means no exemptions, never a failure. Skeleton and field rules: TEMPLATE/docs/ledger-ref-roles-exemptions.example.json.
